description: RS485 analog input/output modules (1 to 8 channels, 0-5 V, 0-10 V, 0/4-20 mA and other ranges), Modbus RTU
source: Analog input/output series user manual, RS485 version V2.0 (Zhongsheng Technology, 2019)

sources.title: 模拟量输入输出系列使用手册 (RS485版) / Analog input/output series user manual, RS485 version
sources.note: section 2, tables 2.1 and 2.2; checked against the English translation attached to issue #71

notes: One map for the whole series: a module has 1 to 8 input and/or output channels, so only the first registers exist on a smaller module.
Function codes 03, 04, 06 and 10. Measured values are input registers; output setpoints and settings are holding registers. Output setpoints are not kept after power off; the settings are.

Values are unsigned 16-bit with three decimals (raw 1000 = 1.000) when the data format register is 2 (fixed 3 decimals). With another data format the scale in this map is wrong: the manual's variable-decimal format puts the number of decimals in the ten-thousands digit (raw 31000 = 1.000).

The manual is inconsistent about the factory data format: section 2.2 calls fixed decimals the factory default, table 2.2 gives a reset value of 0 (variable decimals). Read register 0x3A first and write 2 if needed.
On 0/4-20 mA input models the value is the voltage across the 249 ohm input shunt, in V: divide by 249 to get the current in A (1.000 V = 4.016 mA).
Address, baud rate, data format and parity take effect after a power cycle.
Written from the manufacturer's manual; not tested on a device.
